# Parcel Tracker API

Backend for the parcel tracking app.

## Requirements

- Node 20+
- Postgres 15
- Redis 7

## Local setup

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env
npm run migrate
npm run dev
```

## Environment variables

| Name | Required | Default | Description |
|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| PORT | no | 3000 | HTTP port |
| DATABASE_URL | yes | - | Postgres connection string |
| REDIS_URL | no | - | Redis for job queue |
| LOG_LEVEL | no | info | pino log level |

## Tests

```bash
npm test
```

## Deploy

See docs/deploy.md.
